# Created by the script cgal_create_cmake_script
# This is the CMake script for compiling a CGAL application.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12...3.31)
project(Minkowski_sum_2_Examples)

find_package(CGAL REQUIRED OPTIONAL_COMPONENTS Qt6)

find_package(Boost COMPONENTS program_options)
if(NOT Boost_PROGRAM_OPTIONS_FOUND)
  message(STATUS "NOTICE: The benchmark requires Boost Program Options, and will not be compiled.")
  return()
endif()

# The target is listed explicitly rather than globbed: in an in-source build,
# the sources generated by Qt (qrc_*.cpp) would be picked up as well.
create_single_source_cgal_program("minkowski_sum.cpp")

target_link_libraries(minkowski_sum PRIVATE Boost::program_options)

if(CGAL_Qt6_FOUND)
  target_link_libraries(minkowski_sum PRIVATE CGAL::CGAL_Basic_viewer)
else()
  message(STATUS "NOTICE: The benchmark 'minkowski_sum' requires Qt to draw; drawing will be disabled.")
endif()
